beats.say: 25 years: Harry Kane finally wins the Ballon d'Or.
A quarter of a century is an entire generation waiting for this trophy.
According to the BBC, he is the first England player to win in 25 years.
He also became the fifth Englishman ever to lift the golden ball.
The ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium.
This marked the very first time the event was staged outside France.
Alexia Putellas also triumphed, winning the Ballon d'Or Feminin for the third time.
London hosted a landmark night that redefined modern football history.
